subject: AWS ACE enrollment & stakeholder matchmaking — NexusLink opportunity
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Torres <emily.torres@nexuslink.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 3 Sep 2025 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: AWS ACE enrollment & stakeholder matchmaking — NexusLink opportunity

Hi Emily,

Great speaking with you on Monday — thanks again for the time. We moved NexusLink to the active pipeline after the product workshop and want to get ACE registration started so we can engage the AWS co-sell motion. Two asks to help move this fast: 

1) Quick PDM/PSM introductions so we have the right AWS stakeholders aligned (technical and GTM).
2) A short mutual action plan (3–4 items) and procurement contact for any paperwork.

I attached a filled ACE enrollment form and a first-pass MOP (marketplace onboarding plan) you can share with your team. Proposed next steps: 
- You confirm the procurement contact and signoff cadence
- We loop in AWS PDM/PSM via introductions (copy me)
- Schedule a 30-min ACE kickoff next week to review listing readiness and co-sell approach

Are you available for a 30-min slot on Thu 9/11 or Fri 9/12? If not, send times that work and we'll accommodate.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround on this.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior GTM Manager, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Attachments: NexusLink_ACE_Enrollment_Form.pdf (application/pdf); NexusLink_MOP_v1.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

From: Emily Torres <emily.torres@nexuslink.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@nexuslink.com
Date: Wed, 3 Sep 2025 17:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS ACE enrollment & stakeholder matchmaking — NexusLink opportunity

Hi Kimberly — thanks for the note and the materials. I've shared the enrollment form with procurement; their lead is Priya Singh (procurement@nexuslink.com) and I've CC'd the team.

PDM/PSM: we have initial contacts on the AWS side — Samir Patel (PDM) and Alicia Wong (PSM). I can ask them to join the kickoff. I’m available Fri 9/12 10:00–11:00 PT for the 30-min session. If that works for your side, please lock it in and include the AWS contacts.

Two quick questions from procurement:
- Any standard PO or SOW templates we should expect?
- Will Redwood require a separate marketplace contract or will this be covered under the standard commercial terms?

I’ll wait for your calendar invite.

Cheers,
Emily Torres
Head of Partnerships, NexusLink
emily.torres@nexuslink.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Torres <emily.torres@nexuslink.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@amazon.com>, Alicia Wong <alicia.wong@amazon.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 4 Sep 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS ACE enrollment & stakeholder matchmaking — NexusLink opportunity

Thanks Emily — looping in our deal lead and marketplace owner to coordinate logistics. Samir/Alicia — great to e-meet. A bit of context on NexusLink: they’re an enterprise SaaS vendor in supply chain analytics, pursuing a Q4 pilot with an initial 10k monthly volume projection. The main technical checklist we’ll need to clear: listing artifact set, security questionnaire (SOC2 evidence), and a brief pilot success metric doc.

Concrete asks before the kickoff: 
- AWS: can you confirm the ACE registration point person and any registration ID we should reference?
- NexusLink procurement: please advise on standard PO timing and whether a marketplace contract is preferred.
- Redwood: we’ll provide a marketplace listing checklist and a short readiness deck — Marissa is on the listing artifacts.

Kimberly/Marissa, I’ve penciled the kickoff for Fri 2025-09-12 10:00 PT and will send a calendar invite once Samir/Alicia confirm.

-Karthik
VP, Partnerships
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

Date: Wed, 10 Sep 2025 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS ACE enrollment & stakeholder matchmaking — NexusLink opportunity

Hi all — sorry for the delay, been finalizing a regional planning window. Happy to join the kickoff on Fri 9/12 10:00 PT. For ACE registration: my team generated registration ID ACE-987654 for NexusLink and I'll add Alicia (PSM) to the enrollment so she can support the GTM plan.

Quick notes for the agenda (15 mins):
- Confirm ACE registration ID and ownership (Samir)
- Review listing readiness & outstanding artifacts (Redwood / Marissa)
- Procurement path: marketplace listing vs. direct deal (NexusLink / Procurement)
- Pilot goals + expected support model (NexusLink / Redwood)

Kimberly/Karthik — please include the HubSpot deal link in the invite and Marissa, can you attach the listing checklist and security evidence summary ahead of the call? Emily/Priya — if procurement prefers, we can route an initial SOW through the marketplace path to accelerate co-sell incentives; we can discuss binding terms on the call.

Thanks — Samir
Partner Development Manager, AWS
samir.patel@amazon.com
